responsibility: Drive the existing hybrid pipeline CLI, SQL extraction, local composition and compatible checkpoint resume.

interfaces.input: erl CLI (pipeline.cli:main), Settings, run/date, source-schema contract and inbox deliveries.
interfaces.output: Landing Parquet/manifests, checkpoint state/run report; invokes declared public dependencies locally or AWS services in AWS mode.

invariants: Reject incompatible checkpoints before state mutation; preserve evidence origin.
Compose published contracts; preserve commit visibility, quality gating and exact decimals.
external_resources: Source/consumer SQL engines, inbox/data paths, dbt project/runtime; in AWS mode SSO data-dev, sa-east-1, S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, SNS.
state_and_effects: Reads sources/inbox; writes landing, local checkpoint/report/warehouse and orchestrates downstream effects. One pipeline at a time, stable sources during extraction.

lifecycle.build: Offline build_artifacts.py --unit apps/hybrid-runner; ZIP requires the declared locked external Python environment.
lifecycle.deploy: Local Python application/API; no dedicated cloud deployment. Runner bundles only its declared public_dependencies.
lifecycle.rollback: Rebuild/test selected Git commit with locked dependencies; does not revert data/schema/state.
lifecycle.remove: Update declared callers and local packaging; preserve data, contracts and unrelated executable units.
